stunting_risk.title: Protein & Linear Growth Fortification Plan
stunting_risk.summary: Focuses on high-quality proteins, calcium, and zinc to support linear bone development and height velocity.
recommendations: Include dairy daily: 1-2 glasses of boiled milk, fresh paneer, or set curd (dahi).
Incorporate protein-dense pulses and legumes: sprouted moong, boiled chana, rajma, and soya chunks.
Add calcium-rich traditional grains: ragi (finger millet) porridge/dosas and sesame (til) chikki or laddoos.
Consume seasonal eggs (boiled or scrambled) or local fresh fish for non-vegetarian children.
Ensure adequate sun exposure (15-20 minutes daily) for natural vitamin D synthesis supporting calcium absorption.

severe_stunting.title: Intensive Linear Growth & Micronutrient Recovery Plan
severe_stunting.summary: Targeted clinical nutritional support to address severe height deficits with micronutrient-fortified indigenous meals.
recommendations: Daily fortified dairy: 2 full glasses of warm milk enriched with roasted ragi or almond powder, plus fresh paneer.
Dual-pulse combinations: Dal enriched with moringa (drumstick) leaves, spinach, and sprouted beans.
Animal proteins: 1 boiled egg daily or fish curry twice weekly for optimal amino acid profile.
Zinc and iron sources: Roasted pumpkin seeds, roasted Bengal gram (chana), and jaggery snacks.
Consult a pediatrician or pediatric nutritionist for targeted micronutrient supplements (Zinc, Vitamin D3, Iron).

underweight_risk.title: Energy-Dense Nourishment & Healthy Weight Gain Plan
underweight_risk.summary: Increases caloric and nutrient density through wholesome traditional Indian foods without refined sugars or junk food.
recommendations: Add healthy fats: Add 1-2 teaspoons of pure desi cow ghee or cold-pressed mustard/groundnut oil to hot dal, rice, or khichdi.
Nutrient-rich snacks: Banana with peanut butter or jaggery, mixed roasted nuts (almonds, walnuts), and roasted makhanas (fox nuts).
Wholesome meal schedule: 3 balanced main meals supplemented with 2 wholesome mid-morning and evening snacks.
Calorie-dense porridges: Suji (semolina) kheer or ragi malt prepared with full-cream milk and crushed nuts.
Enriched khichdi: Moong dal khichdi loaded with mixed seasonal vegetables (carrots, green peas, pumpkin) and generous ghee.

severe_underweight.title: High-Calorie Intensive Recovery & Muscle Mass Plan
severe_underweight.summary: Urgent therapeutic dietary schedule to rebuild body mass, immune resilience, and vital tissue reserves.
recommendations: Nutrient-dense liquid meals: Sattu drink with milk/curd, homemade peanut-banana milkshakes, and whole milk paneer puree.
Ghee-enriched staples: Generous pure ghee added to all warm meals including dalia (broken wheat), parathas, and rice dishes.
Frequent feeding: Provide small, highly nourishing energy-dense meals every 2.5 to 3 hours.
High-energy traditional snacks: Dry fruit laddoos made with dates, almonds, sesame seeds, and ghee (no refined sugar).
Urgent medical consultation with primary health care worker or pediatric clinic for growth monitoring.

thinness_risk.title: Muscle Mass & Acute Nourishment Recovery Plan
thinness_risk.summary: Restores balanced body mass index through easily digestible protein-carbohydrate combinations and gut health support.
recommendations: High-protein grain blends: Multigrain rotis (wheat, jowar, gram flour/besan) with seasonal sabzi and thick dal.
Digestible protein: Fresh curd/buttermilk (chaas), sprouted moong chaat with lemon juice, and boiled egg whites.
Wholesome breakfast: Poha or upma garnished with roasted groundnuts, boiled sprouts, and fresh coriander.
Hydration with electrolytes: Tender coconut water and homemade lemon water with a pinch of rock salt.
Ensure boiled or filtered drinking water to prevent gastrointestinal infections and optimize nutrient absorption.

severe_thinness.title: Therapeutic Nutritional Rehabilitation Plan
severe_thinness.summary: Immediate nutritional rehabilitation designed to reverse severe acute wasting and replenish muscle glycogen.
recommendations: Energy-dense soft foods: Soft-cooked moong dal and rice mash enriched with butter/ghee and mashed sweet potato.
Concentrated protein: Daily boiled eggs, fresh paneer bhurji, or roasted besan sheera prepared with milk.
Frequent hydration: Offer buttermilk (chaas) enriched with roasted cumin and mineral-rich soups (tomato-lentil broth).
Gentle digestive care: Avoid spicy, fried, or ultra-processed foods that may cause indigestion or diarrhea.
Immediate clinical evaluation at nearest health camp or Primary Health Centre (PHC).

overweight_risk.title: Balanced Fiber-Rich & Active Lifestyle Nutrition Plan
overweight_risk.summary: Promotes whole foods, complex dietary fiber, and active metabolism while curbing ultra-processed snacks and added sugars.
recommendations: Switch to whole millets & unpolished grains: Jowar, bajra, ragi rotis, and brown/hand-pounded rice instead of refined maida.
Salad before meals: Fresh sliced cucumbers, carrots, and tomatoes with lemon dressing prior to lunch and dinner.
Eliminate sugary beverages: Avoid sodas, packaged juices, and commercial sweets; replace with water, chaas, or lemon water.
Healthy evening snacks: Roasted makhanas, boiled corn chaat, or roasted chana instead of deep-fried packaged chips.
Promote 45-60 minutes of daily physical play, cycling, running, or outdoor games.

obesity_risk.title: Metabolic Health & Whole Foods Nutrition Plan
obesity_risk.summary: Structured nutritional guidelines focused on whole grains, portion mindfulness, hydration, and regular aerobic activity.
recommendations: High-fiber plate rule: Ensure 50% of the meal plate consists of fresh green vegetables, salads, and seasonal fruits.
Strict avoidance of ultra-processed food: Eliminate bakery goods, sugary packaged cereals, fried snacks, and sodas.
Healthy cooking methods: Prefer steaming, boiling, pressure cooking, and light roasting over deep frying.
Scheduled meal timing: Avoid late-night snacking and ensure dinner is completed at least 2 hours before bedtime.
Encourage structured daily sports, yoga, swimming, or active outdoor games for at least 60 minutes.
Consult a healthcare professional to monitor metabolic health indicators.

normal_growth.title: Balanced Regional Indian Nutrition & Maintenance Plan
normal_growth.summary: Maintains optimal child growth, cognitive vitality, and immune strength with a diverse traditional diet.
recommendations: Balanced Indian Thali: Maintain a daily plate of whole grain roti/rice, green vegetables, dal/pulses, and fresh curd.
Daily fresh fruit: Include 1 whole seasonal fruit (papaya, guava, banana, apple, or orange) between meals.
Stay hydrated: Drink 6-8 glasses of clean water daily, supplemented with fresh buttermilk (chaas) or coconut water.
Snack smart: Prefer wholesome homemade snacks such as roasted murmura, roasted peanuts, chana, and fruits.
Maintain active daily outdoor sports and at least 8 hours of restful sleep every night.
